In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation of cucurbitane triterpenoids from the leaves of M. charantia, the assessment of their cancer chemopreventive activities and cytotoxicities.
the isolation and structural elucidation of 17 cucurbitane triterpenoids including six new compounds from a MeOH leaf extract of Japanese Momordicacharantia.
the chemical investigation of the MeOH extract of Japanese M. charantia, which led to the isolation of 17 cucurbitane triterpenoids including six new compounds.

compounds 1–11 and 14–17 are the active components of M. charantia, which are responsible for the anti‐cancer chemopreventive effects, and compounds 2, and 5–9 are responsible for the cytotoxic activities against human cancer cell line.

compounds 1–12, 14, 16, and 17 could be potential candidates for cancer chemopreventive agents.
